scope: Authority research only; no legal applicability or operating approval.

modules.distinction: Ontario machinery research starts with the industrial workplace context. ESA and TSSA questions remain distinct from workplace safety and environmental permission research.

topics.research_question: Confirm OHSA and industrial-sector scope; use current e-Laws instruments before stating duties.
topics.required_evidence: Workplace regime, undertaking, facility activity, applicable sector and assessment date

topics.research_question: Research Regulation 851 machinery provisions and whether a pre-start review question arises for the proposed change; do not assume every modification qualifies.
topics.required_evidence: Machine identity, task, guarding evidence, modification history and engineering documents

topics.research_question: Research task-specific energy-isolation provisions in the current industrial regulation; do not copy another province's procedure.
topics.required_evidence: Task and equipment scope, all energy types, existing site procedure and authorized review owner

topics.research_question: Separate workplace electrical safety research from ESA installation/code and notification questions.
topics.required_evidence: Work versus installation scope, location, equipment, proposed change and existing permit evidence
topics.review_owner: Qualified electrical reviewer and authority having jurisdiction

topics.research_question: Research Regulation 220/01 and the applicable adoption document with equipment facts; do not infer exemption from size alone.
topics.required_evidence: Equipment type, service, nameplate/design records, location and proposed lifecycle activity
topics.review_owner: Qualified pressure-equipment reviewer and competent authority

topics.research_question: Research ECA versus EASR and other permission routes for the actual activity; existing registration is not proof for a changed process.
topics.required_evidence: Activity, emissions/discharges/waste, location, receiving environment and existing permissions

topics.research_question: Research applicable awareness and task-specific training requirements separately; attendance is not demonstrated competence.
topics.required_evidence: Worker role, task and equipment, training content, demonstrated competency and supervision evidence

modules.distinction: Technical Safety BC identifies local electrical/gas jurisdiction exceptions. Select the authority by location and technology; do not generalize an electrical exception to pressure equipment.

topics.research_question: Check WorkSafeBC inspectional jurisdiction and relevant Workers Compensation Act/OHS Regulation scope before selecting duties.
topics.required_evidence: Workplace regime, undertaking, facility activity, applicable sector and assessment date

topics.research_question: Use the Part 12 research path and equipment-specific provisions; keep regulations distinct from interpretive guidelines.
topics.required_evidence: Machine identity, task, guarding evidence, modification history and engineering documents

topics.research_question: Use the Part 10 research path with task and energy evidence; no equivalence with an Ontario program is assumed.
topics.required_evidence: Task and equipment scope, all energy types, existing site procedure and authorized review owner

topics.research_question: Check local electrical jurisdiction with Technical Safety BC; separately research workplace electrical safety through WorkSafeBC Part 19.
topics.required_evidence: Work versus installation scope, location, equipment, proposed change and existing permit evidence
topics.review_owner: Qualified electrical reviewer and authority having jurisdiction

topics.research_question: Research the pressure technology, applicable safety regulation and lifecycle permissions independently of electrical municipal exceptions.
topics.required_evidence: Equipment type, service, nameplate/design records, location and proposed lifecycle activity
topics.review_owner: Qualified pressure-equipment reviewer and competent authority

topics.research_question: Research each waste/discharge activity and receiving medium; one authorization need not cover all activities.
topics.required_evidence: Activity, emissions/discharges/waste, location, receiving environment and existing permissions

topics.research_question: Research orientation and task/equipment training provisions for the actual worker role; do not equate a general course with all required evidence.
topics.required_evidence: Worker role, task and equipment, training content, demonstrated competency and supervision evidence

modules.distinction: Alberta separates OHS research, local safety-code services, ABSA pressure-equipment oversight and environmental approval research. A Code update date does not prove current text for every subject.

topics.research_question: Start with the OHS Act, Regulation and Code; check effective amendments for the requested date, not only a 2025 summary.
topics.required_evidence: Workplace regime, undertaking, facility activity, applicable sector and assessment date

topics.research_question: Find the current Code equipment/safeguard requirements for the actual machine and task; preserve manufacturer and engineering evidence separately.
topics.required_evidence: Machine identity, task, guarding evidence, modification history and engineering documents

topics.research_question: Research the current Code hazardous-energy provisions and task conditions; do not substitute a 2009 download or cross-province procedure.
topics.required_evidence: Task and equipment scope, all energy types, existing site procedure and authorized review owner

topics.research_question: Identify the local accredited municipality or agency and applicable discipline/code; keep workplace safety and installation permission separate.
topics.required_evidence: Work versus installation scope, location, equipment, proposed change and existing permit evidence
topics.review_owner: Qualified electrical reviewer and authority having jurisdiction

topics.research_question: Use ABSA to research pressure-equipment scope and the applicable Safety Codes Act instruments; a registration record alone is not operating permission.
topics.required_evidence: Equipment type, service, nameplate/design records, location and proposed lifecycle activity
topics.review_owner: Qualified pressure-equipment reviewer and competent authority

topics.research_question: Research EPEA approval, registration and associated conditions for each activity; do not assign a route without classification evidence.
topics.required_evidence: Activity, emissions/discharges/waste, location, receiving environment and existing permissions

topics.research_question: Research training, competency and supervision requirements by task and role; a course date does not prove continuing competence.
topics.required_evidence: Worker role, task and equipment, training content, demonstrated competency and supervision evidence

modules.distinction: Quebec sources retain their French identity and instrument version. The observed OHS consolidation ends on 2026-04-01; currency through a later activity remains unresolved.

topics.research_question: Preserve the official French title, instrument identifier and consolidation date; research Act/regulation scope with the workplace owner.
topics.required_evidence: Workplace regime, undertaking, facility activity, applicable sector and assessment date

topics.research_question: Research the current machinery provisions and change history in the official regulation; translated extracts must retain the original source.
topics.required_evidence: Machine identity, task, guarding evidence, modification history and engineering documents

topics.research_question: Use cadenassage/control-of-energy research for the actual task; do not treat a translated Ontario procedure as Quebec conformity.
topics.required_evidence: Task and equipment scope, all energy types, existing site procedure and authorized review owner

topics.research_question: Use RBQ electrical research for applicable chapters and installation context; maintain workplace safety and professional qualification questions separately.
topics.required_evidence: Work versus installation scope, location, equipment, proposed change and existing permit evidence
topics.review_owner: Qualified electrical reviewer and authority having jurisdiction

topics.research_question: Use RBQ pressure-installation research with type, service and activity evidence; do not infer applicability from a provincial registration elsewhere.
topics.required_evidence: Equipment type, service, nameplate/design records, location and proposed lifecycle activity
topics.review_owner: Qualified pressure-equipment reviewer and competent authority

topics.research_question: Research LQE/REAFIE activity conditions and applicable authorization route without assigning a risk level from the plant's industry label.
topics.required_evidence: Activity, emissions/discharges/waste, location, receiving environment and existing permissions

topics.research_question: Research role/task training requirements and comprehension evidence; translated attendance records do not establish practical competency.
topics.required_evidence: Worker role, task and equipment, training content, demonstrated competency and supervision evidence
